sources.name: Wilfrid Laurier University Brantford - International Student Support
sources.notes: The single best-fit source for this city - Laurier's Brantford campus international office runs orientation, welcome breakfasts and workshops. Its events/workshops sub-page 404s when fetched directly (WLU's CMS returns a custom 404 handler for bot UAs) and Laurier's central Dude Solutions widget (events.dudesolutions.com/wlu/events) also 404s - confirmed 2026-08-26. Contact lbinternational@wlu.ca for the Brantford-specific calendar until a working route is found.

sources.name: YMCA Immigrant Services - Brantford
sources.notes: 100 Water St, Brantford. Settlement services (health, education, language help, multilingual staff) for immigrants and newcomers; part of YMCA of Hamilton/Burlington/Brantford. No dated-events feed found - hand-enter workshops/info sessions as announced.

sources.name: Brantford Immigration Partnership (BIP)
sources.notes: City-run local immigration partnership; hosts the annual Newcomer Welcome Day (Lion's Park Steve Brown Sports Complex, held ~late July 2025) and periodic newcomer info sessions. No feed on the City's GovStack CMS - hand-enter dated events, contact bip@brantford.ca.

sources.name: Conestoga College - Brantford Campus
sources.notes: Brantford campus (business, community services, trades diplomas/certificates) with a sizeable international cohort and a LINC free-English-classes program mentioned for newcomers. No campus-specific events feed found on a first pass - college-wide international site is a general info page, not a calendar. Re-probe for a dudesolutions or tribe-style calendar.

sources.name: County of Brant Public Library
sources.notes: LibCal (Springshare) system for the County of Brant Public Library (Paris, St. George, Burford, Scotland branches - the county surrounding Brantford, distinct from the city's own Brantford Public Library below). Found the working feed by reading the calendar page's inline iCalUrlBase JS config, then guessing the query param name (cid, not cal_id) - confirmed live 2026-08-26, 189 VEVENTs in the feed, DTSTART in UTC (Z-suffixed) so the generic ical parser's UTC handling applies. Good volume but skews toward general library programming (knitting circles, author talks) - keyword scoring will need to do the filtering for newcomer/student relevance.

sources.name: Brantford Public Library
sources.notes: Runs the GovStack/eSolutionsGroup calendar platform (same Azure-hosted app family, appId cid-v1:06dd76cf-d990-4513-9041-6103499b5b9b, as calendar.brantford.ca and calendar.discoverbrantford.ca below). New generic `govstack_calendar` parser added 2026-09-09: the month grid at /default/Month?StartDate=MM/DD/YYYY is server-rendered plain HTML (no JS needed), and each event's own /default/Detail/YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-slug link encodes its start date+time directly. Confirmed working - also unlocked the city and tourism calendars below, plus Thunder Bay's and Kitchener's city calendars, same day.

sources.name: City of Brantford Events Calendar
sources.notes: Same GovStack platform as the library calendar above - unlocked 2026-09-09 by the new `govstack_calendar` parser, see that entry.

sources.name: Discover Brantford Tourism Calendar
sources.notes: Redirects to calendar.brantford.ca/discoverbrantford - unlike the library/city calendars on this same GovStack platform (unlocked 2026-09-09, see brantford-library entry), this path does NOT expose the standard /default/Month grid the new govstack_calendar parser expects (confirmed: /discoverbrantford/default/Month 404s, and /discoverbrantford itself returns a 101KB page with no /default/Detail/ links or Month-view links at all - some other view entirely, not investigated further). City festivals already covered via city-brantford-events and hand-entered manual_events.

sources.name: City of Brantford Festivals (hand-entered)
sources.notes: Sourced from web search since the City's own calendar has no feed (see city-brantford-events probe below) - Ribfest and Afro-CariBrant Festival hand-entered here with verify caveats.

sources.name: Downtown Brantford BIA
sources.notes: WordPress + The Events Calendar, confirmed live via wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events 2026-08-26 (200 OK, valid empty result set at probe time - no events currently posted that far out). Runs DuckFest, Scare in the Square, and Harmony Square family events; will populate once the BIA posts to its own calendar rather than only Facebook/Eventbrite.

sources.name: Good Neighbour Chinese Church / Brantford Chinese Alliance Church
sources.notes: Mandarin/Cantonese-language church running a university-student transition seminar series (大学生系列讲座) aimed at international students - the clearest spiritual fit found for Brantford. Standing Sunday (2-3:15pm, currently via Zoom) and Thursday (7-8:30pm) programs, no dated-event feed. Registered manual with an empty list per the no-recurring-events rule; contact pastor@brantfordcac.org for specific dated sessions.

sources.name: Sanderson Centre
sources.notes: Flipped from probe to manual 2026-11-02 (must-do sweep): no feed found (still no tribe/ical/govstack route), but the venue's 2026-2027 season was directly confirmed via the City of Brantford's own announcement post, not a ticketing aggregator. Three Dec 2026 shows hand-entered as manual_events; check sandersoncentre.ca directly for anything added to the season later.

sources.name: Freedom House Santa Claus Parade & Parade After Party
sources.notes: Added 2026-11-02 from the must-do events sweep: directly confirmed on the City's own ParadeAfterParty page (not a search snippet) - resolves a conflicting third-party listing (Rogers TV) that gave the wrong date (Nov 21). The parade runs Dalhousie St (Stanley St to King St), free parking at 59 Icomm Drive; the after-party at Harmony Square opens with the official tree lighting.

sources.name: Brantford's New Year's Eve Celebration (Harmony Square)
sources.notes: Added 2026-11-02 from the must-do events sweep. Annual free event at Harmony Square (live entertainment, fireworks, weather-dependent DJ skate party) - now in its third year (started 2024). The City had not published its 2026 program/hours as of this sweep (2026-10-19 onward, confirmed no 2026 announcement found) - date (Dec 31) is fixed by the calendar, hand-enter exact hours once brantford.ca posts them.

sources.name: Glenhyrst Art Gallery of Brant
sources.notes: Added 2026-10-19 from the must-do events sweep: 'Brantford Lights at Glenhyrst' (Dec-Jan) was missing from this city's board. Venue/calendar site with many events - needs a parser (probe until then).

sources.name: City of Brantford Remembrance Day Services
sources.notes: Added 2026-10-21 from the must-do events sweep: the civic Remembrance Day service at the Brant County War Memorial was missing from this city's board - the kind of civic event a general-purpose assistant would surface even though it isn't student-specific. Recent years' format: a walking march from Harmony Square to the memorial, a civic service with a fly-past, an overnight cenotaph lighting display and cadet vigil from 6pm Nov 10 to 10:30am Nov 11. 2026's official city announcement not yet posted as of this sweep (only a third-party aggregator listing found) - hand-enter confirmed 2026 times as manual_events once brantford.ca/RemembranceDay publishes them.

Seating at the main service has been restricted to veterans and companions in recent years.

End time is an estimate (not stated on the page); tree lighting opens the after-party at Harmony Square once the parade arrives.

Confirm on brantford.ca before drafting.
